hypotheses.R0_pure_semantic_program_transfers: At some tested layer with at least 64 effectful rows in every ordered pair, every pure pair has global-ridge semantic fidelity at least 0.50.
hypotheses.R1_semantic_program_is_not_a_neuron_perm: At the best adjudicative pure semantic layer, mean global-ridge fidelity exceeds native-permutation fidelity by at least 0.15.
hypotheses.R2_tensor_write_quotient_transfers_seman: At some adjudicative layer, every pure pair has write-quotient semantic fidelity at least 0.50.
hypotheses.R3_relation_conditioning_improves_semant: At some adjudicative layer, relation-conditioned semantic fidelity exceeds global-ridge fidelity by at least 0.10.
hypotheses.R4_arbitrary_fact_swaps_do_not_share_one: At every adjudicative layer, mean mixed global-ridge arbitrary-swap fidelity is below 0.30.
hypotheses.R5_tensor_quotient_recovers_arbitrary_sw: At some adjudicative layer, mean mixed write-quotient arbitrary-swap fidelity exceeds global ridge by 0.15 and reaches 0.30.
hypotheses.R6_semantic_transfer_is_more_recurrent_t: At the best adjudicative pure semantic layer, global-ridge semantic fidelity exceeds generic-pair fidelity by at least 0.20.
hypotheses.R7_own_delta_is_an_effectful_ceiling: Every regime, family, and layer has at least 64 effectful rows in every ordered pair.
